<js>
var html = String(result);
var d = html.match(/initTxt\("([^"]+)"/);
if (!d) '内容加载失败';
else {
    var u = d[1];
    if (u.indexOf('//') === 0) u = 'https:' + u;
    var s = String(java.ajax(u));
    var j = s.match(/_txt_call\((\{[\s\S]*\})\)/);
    if (!j) '解析失败';
    else {
        var c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"\s*,\s*"replace"/);
        if (!c) c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"/);
        if (!c) '无content';
        else {
            var ct = c[1].replace(/\\n/g,'\n').replace(/\\r/g,'\r').replace(/\\t/g,'\t').replace(/\\"/g,'"').replace(/\\\\/g,'\\');
            var r = /"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*"((?:\\b|\\n|[\s\S]))"/g;
            var m;
            while ((m = r.exec(j[1])) !== null) {
                ct = ct.split(m[2]).join(m[1]);
            }
            ct = ct.replace(/&#x([0-9a-fA-F]+);/g, function(_, h) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)) });
            ct = ct.replace(/&#(\d+);/g, function(_, d) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(d, 10)) });
            var b = html.match(/ttf;base64,([^\)]+)/);
            if (b) try { ct = String(java.replaceFont(ct, java.queryBase64TTF(b[1]), java.queryTTF("https://alanskycn.gitee.io/teachme/assets/font/Source Han Sans CN Regular.ttf"), true)) } catch(e) {}
            ct = ct.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
            ct.split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.trim() && !/AILISW|ailisw|温馨提示|加载中/.test(l) }).join('\n');
        }
    }
}
</js>
